```sql
-- =====================================================================
-- Nordvik - przykładowe zapytania analityczne (PostgreSQL)
-- Schemat przykładowy: sklepy/zamówienia sieci Nordvik
--   customers(customer_id, email, city, country, created_at, segment)
--   products(product_id, name, category, unit_cost, unit_price)
--   orders(order_id, customer_id, store_id, ordered_at, status, channel)
--   order_items(order_id, product_id, quantity, discount_pct)
--   stores(store_id, city, region)
-- =====================================================================


-- 1. Dzienna sprzedaż netto i liczba zamówień (ostatnie 90 dni)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', o.ordered_at)::date                          AS sale_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                                     AS orders_cnt,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100))  AS net_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.ordered_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;


-- 2. Marża i udział kategorii w przychodzie (ostatni kwartał)
WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100))      AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity * (p.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)
                           - p.unit_cost))                                  AS gross_margin
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.ordered_at >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')
      AND o.ordered_at <  DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2)                                              AS revenue,
    ROUND(gross_margin / NULLIF(revenue, 0) * 100, 2)              AS margin_pct,
    ROUND(revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER () * 100, 2)                 AS revenue_share_pct
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY revenue DESC;


-- 3. Kohorty klientów: retencja miesięczna
WITH first_order AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(ordered_at))::date AS cohort_month
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)::date AS activity_month
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
)
SELECT
    f.cohort_month,
    (EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM a.activity_month) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.activity_month))
  - (EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM f.cohort_month)  * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.cohort_month))  AS months_since_first,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id)                                                    AS active_customers,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id)::numeric
          / FIRST_VALUE(COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id))
              OVER (PARTITION BY f.cohort_month ORDER BY
                    (EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM a.activity_month) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.activity_month))
                  - (EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM f.cohort_month)  * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.cohort_month))) * 100, 1)
                                                                                     AS retention_pct
FROM first_order f
JOIN activity a ON a.customer_id = f.customer_id
WHERE a.activity_month >= f.cohort_month
GROUP BY f.cohort_month, months_since_first
ORDER BY f.cohort_month, months_since_first;


-- 4. Klienci o wysokiej wartości (RFM - Recency, Frequency, Monetary)
WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        CURRENT_DATE - MAX(o.ordered_at)::date                         AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                                     AS frequency,
        SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100))  AS monetary
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days DESC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency)          AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary)           AS m_score
    FROM customer_metrics
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    recency_days,
    frequency,
    ROUND(monetary, 2) AS monetary,
    r_score, f_score, m_score,
    CASE
        WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score <= 2                  THEN 'Nowy / obiecujący'
        WHEN r_score <= 2 AND f_score >= 3                  THEN 'Zagrożony odejściem'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS segment
FROM scored
ORDER BY monetary DESC
LIMIT 100;


-- 5. Anomalie: sklepy z nagłym spadkiem sprzedaży tydzień do tygodnia (> 30%)
WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT
        o.store_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', o.ordered_at)::date AS week_start,
        SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.ordered_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
    GROUP BY o.store_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', o.ordered_at)
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        store_id,
        week_start,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY week_start) AS prev_revenue
    FROM weekly
)
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.city,
    wp.week_start,
    ROUND(wp.revenue, 2)                                         AS revenue,
    ROUND(wp.prev_revenue, 2)                                    AS prev_revenue,
    ROUND((wp.revenue - wp.prev_revenue) / NULLIF(wp.prev_revenue, 0) * 100, 1) AS change_pct
FROM with_prev wp
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = wp.store_id
WHERE wp.prev_revenue > 0
  AND (wp.revenue - wp.prev_revenue) / wp.prev_revenue < -0.30
ORDER BY change_pct;


-- 6. Dane do modelu churn: cechy na poziomie klienta (okno 90 dni przed datą odniesienia)
WITH params AS (
    SELECT CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' AS feature_cutoff,
           CURRENT_DATE                      AS label_end
),
features AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.segment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                                    AS orders_90d,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price), 0)                  AS gross_spend_90d,
        COALESCE(AVG(oi.discount_pct), 0)                             AS avg_discount_90d,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel)                                     AS channels_used
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN orders o
           ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
          AND o.status = 'completed'
          AND o.ordered_at >= pr.feature_cutoff
          AND o.ordered_at <  pr.label_end - INTERVAL '90 days' + INTERVAL '90 days'
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment
),
labels AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM orders o2
            WHERE o2.customer_id = c.customer_id
              AND o2.status = 'completed'
              AND o2.ordered_at >= pr.label_end - INTERVAL '90 days'
        ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS churned_next_90d
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN params pr
)
SELECT
    f.customer_id,
    f.segment,
    f.orders_90d,
    f.gross_spend_90d,
    f.avg_discount_90d,
    f.channels_used,
    l.churned_next_90d
FROM features f
JOIN labels l USING (customer_id)
LIMIT 10000;
```

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, classification_report, RocCurveDisplay

RNG = np.random.default_rng(42)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
plt.rcParams["figure.figsize"] = (9, 4)"""),
md("## 1. Dane syntetyczne\n\nSymulujemy klientów, zamówienia i pozycje – te same nazwy co w `nordvik_sample_queries.sql`."),
code("""N_CUSTOMERS = 5_000
END = pd.Timestamp("2026-11-08")
START = END - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

customers = pd.DataFrame({
    "customer_id": np.arange(1, N_CUSTOMERS + 1),
    "city": RNG.choice(["Oslo", "Bergen", "Trondheim", "Stavanger", "Tromsø"], N_CUSTOMERS, p=[.35, .2, .2, .15, .1]),
    "segment": RNG.choice(["retail", "premium", "b2b"], N_CUSTOMERS, p=[.7, .2, .1]),
    "created_at": START - pd.to_timedelta(RNG.integers(0, 900, N_CUSTOMERS), unit="D"),
})

# Każdy klient ma wewnętrzną "skłonność" do zakupów; część klientów odpada (churn)
customers["rate"] = RNG.gamma(2.0, 0.6, N_CUSTOMERS)
customers["churn_day"] = END - pd.to_timedelta(RNG.integers(0, 365, N_CUSTOMERS), unit="D")
customers["will_churn"] = RNG.random(N_CUSTOMERS) < 0.25
customers.loc[~customers["will_churn"], "churn_day"] = END + pd.Timedelta(days=1)

orders = []
for cid, rate, churn_day in customers[["customer_id", "rate", "churn_day"]].itertuples(index=False):
    n = RNG.poisson(rate * 6)
    days = RNG.integers(0, 365, n)
    for d in days:
        ts = START + pd.Timedelta(days=int(d), hours=int(RNG.integers(8, 22)))
        if ts < churn_day:
            orders.append((cid, ts, RNG.choice(["web", "app", "store"], p=[.3, .3, .4])))
orders = pd.DataFrame(orders, columns=["customer_id", "ordered_at", "channel"])
orders.insert(0, "order_id", np.arange(1, len(orders) + 1))
orders["status"] = np.where(RNG.random(len(orders)) < 0.04, "cancelled", "completed")

products = pd.DataFrame({
    "product_id": range(1, 9),
    "name": ["Kawa ziarnista", "Ekspres", "Czajnik", "Ręcznik", "Pościel", "Lampka", "Plecak", "Kurtka"],
    "category": ["Kuchnia", "AGD", "AGD", "Dom", "Dom", "Dom", "Moda", "Moda"],
    "unit_cost": [18, 220, 60, 12, 45, 30, 70, 150],
    "unit_price": [39, 499, 129, 29, 99, 79, 149, 349],
})

items = []
for oid in orders["order_id"]:
    for pid in RNG.choice(products["product_id"], RNG.integers(1, 4), replace=False):
        items.append((oid, pid, int(RNG.integers(1, 3)), float(RNG.choice([0, 0, 0, 10, 20]))))
order_items = pd.DataFrame(items, columns=["order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "discount_pct"])

print(customers.shape, orders.shape, order_items.shape)
orders.head()"""),
md("## 2. Jakość danych"),
code("""print("Brakujące wartości:\\n", orders.isna().sum())
print("\\nDuplikaty order_id:", orders["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print("\\nZamówienia bez pozycji:", (~orders["order_id"].isin(order_items["order_id"])).sum())
print("Rozkład statusów:\\n", orders["status"].value_counts(normalize=True).round(3))"""),
md("## 3. Sprzedaż netto i kategorie\n\nOdpowiednik zapytań 1 i 2 z pliku SQL."),
code("""sales = (
    orders[orders["status"] == "completed"]
    .merge(order_items, on="order_id")
    .merge(products, on="product_id")
)
sales["net_revenue"] = sales["quantity"] * sales["unit_price"] * (1 - sales["discount_pct"] / 100)
sales["gross_margin"] = sales["quantity"] * (sales["unit_price"] * (1 - sales["discount_pct"] / 100) - sales["unit_cost"])

monthly = sales.set_index("ordered_at").resample("MS")["net_revenue"].sum()
ax = monthly.plot(marker="o", title="Miesięczna sprzedaż netto (PLN, symulacja)")
ax.set_ylabel("Przychód")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

by_cat = sales.groupby("category").agg(revenue=("net_revenue", "sum"), margin=("gross_margin", "sum"))
by_cat["margin_pct"] = (by_cat["margin"] / by_cat["revenue"] * 100).round(1)
by_cat["revenue_share_pct"] = (by_cat["revenue"] / by_cat["revenue"].sum() * 100).round(1)
by_cat.sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)"""),
md("## 4. Model churn\n\nCechy liczymy z okna `[T-180d, T-90d)`, etykieta to brak zakupów w `[T-90d, T)`. Dzięki temu model nie widzi przyszłości."),
code("""T = END
feat_start, feat_end = T - pd.Timedelta(days=180), T - pd.Timedelta(days=90)

win = sales[(sales["ordered_at"] >= feat_start) & (sales["ordered_at"] < feat_end)]
features = (
    win.groupby("customer_id")
    .agg(
        orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        gross_spend_90d=("net_revenue", "sum"),
        avg_discount_90d=("discount_pct", "mean"),
